layout.arrangement: Framed lecture slide: thin dark-red border around a light-gray canvas. Centered black title at top with a red/yellow-highlighted subtitle directly beneath; yellow circular slide-number badge at top-right. Upper-left quadrant: a green rounded 'concept' box holding two copies of the attention-score equation, a red 1×d embedding symbol, green d-arrows, and a two-line blue takeaway annotation. A mouse cursor floats just right of this box. Bottom two-thirds: one large peach rounded panel with a header row (red embedding symbol, red 'SoftMax' label, white softmax-equation box, blue-bordered warning strip) and three parallel worked-example columns (green d-arrow label, yellow input vector, thick red arrow labeled 'SoftMax', blue-framed output vector, caption underneath).

typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like) throughout for title, subtitle, labels, numbers and captions; equations in a serif/math-italic style (Cambria Math-like) with true superscripts/subscripts and a built-up fraction. Title ≈28pt bold; subtitle ≈20pt bold; annotation and warning text ≈14pt bold (warning also italic); vector values ≈12pt bold; captions ≈12pt with math-italic w'_{ij}. Heavy use of colored highlight behind key words (yellow, orange); green d-labels bold with arrow glyphs; no bullet lists anywhere on the slide.

recreation_brief: 1. Slide setup: 16:9; background light gray #E9E9E9; draw a no-fill rectangle border ~2.5pt #990000 inset ~2% from all edges. 2. Title text box centered at top (y≈6–12%): 'Self Attention Mechanism', Arial bold 28pt, black. 3. Subtitle beneath (y≈12–17%): '(Embedding Vector Dimension and Softmax Sensitivity)' Arial bold 20pt; color '(Embedding ', ' and ', ')' red #FF0000; give 'Vector Dimension' and 'Softmax Sensitivity' black text with yellow #FFFF00 highlight. 4. Slide number: oval ≈0.5" at top-right (x≈93%, y≈9%), fill #FFFF00, thin #333333 outline, text '34' black bold 12pt. 5. Concept box: rounded rectangle x 5–42%, y 18–48%, no fill, 2pt #00A651 outline. Inside: (a) white rectangle, thin gray border, top-left, equation w′ᵢⱼ = xᵢᵀxⱼ (Cambria Math ≈20pt); (b) red bold '[Xᵢ]₁ₓd' top-right; (c) green bold 'd ↑' mid-left; (d) green block up-arrow at center with smaller white equation box 'w′ᵢⱼ = xᵢᵀxⱼ' (≈12pt) at its right; (e) two-line blue #0000CC bold annotation at bottom: 'As Dimension of Embedding "d" Increases' / 'the Calculated weight value "w" increases', yellow highlight behind 'd', orange #FFA500 highlight with red text behind '"w" increases'. 6. Optional (video-frame fidelity): paste a small mouse-cursor arrow icon at x≈47%, y≈31%. 7. Demo panel: rounded rectangle x 4–96%, y 50–97%, fill #FCE4D4. 8. Panel header row: (a) white box with 1.5pt #C00000 border at far left containing red bold '[Xᵢ]₁ₓd'; (b) red bold 'SoftMax' label; (c) white box with Equation-Editor fraction wᵢⱼ = exp w′ᵢⱼ / Σⱼ exp w′ᵢⱼ; (d) white box with 1.5pt #0000CC border at right, blue bold italic 14pt 'High Weight Values kill the gradient, and slow down learning'. 9. Build one demo column and duplicate twice: green bold label with arrow(s) on top ('d ↓' / 'd ↑' / 'd ↑↑'); left sub-column of four ≈0.35" rounded rectangles, fill #FFFF00, 1.5pt #C00000 border, black bold centered values, stack wrapped in large thin red parentheses; thick red #C00000 right-block-arrow between sub-columns with orange bold 'SoftMax' above it; right sub-column of four white rounded rectangles with 1.5pt #0033CC borders and black bold values, wrapped in large thin blue parentheses; caption below: math-italic 'w′ᵢⱼ' + black 'For small "d"' (col 1), 'For medium "d"' (col 2), 'For large "d"' (col 3). 10. Enter values exactly — col 1 inputs 1,2,3,4 → outputs 0.0321, 0.0871, 0.2369, 0.6439; col 2 inputs 5,10,15,20 → outputs 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0067, 0.9933; col 3 inputs 10,20,30,40 → outputs 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 1.0000; place columns at x≈12–32%, 40–60%, 68–88%.
